Closed now for the season (CPW banner: 'Elks and Inlet Campgrounds are CLOSED for the season'). Seasonal, not a status.

The park's other two drive-in RV campgrounds, Inlet Grove (46 electric sites, 48-98 ft) and Chimney View (43 electric sites, 74-100 ft, open year-round), share one entry, 2245 'North Sterling State Park (Inlet Grove & Chimney View)'; they are separate campgrounds on cpwshop and CPW's page and could be split.
